title: The Battle of Princeton
text: On January 3, 1777, American forces won the Battle of Princeton. The victory followed the crossing of the Delaware and the Battle of Trenton, helping revive the Patriot cause in New Jersey.

title: The Battle of Monmouth
text: On June 28, 1778, the Battle of Monmouth was fought in New Jersey during the American Revolution. It became one of the largest battles of the war in the northern states.

title: New Jersey adopts its first state constitution
text: On July 2, 1776, New Jersey adopted its first state constitution, declaring independence from Great Britain. The constitution remained in effect for 68 years.

title: Voters approve financing for the Garden State Parkway
text: On November 4, 1952, New Jersey voters approved a referendum allowing the Highway Authority to finance construction of the Garden State Parkway with state-backed bonds.

title: New Jersey ratifies the U.S. Constitution
text: On December 18, 1787, New Jersey became the third state to ratify the U.S. Constitution. The state convention in Trenton approved it unanimously.

title: Washington's forces win the Battle of Trenton
text: On December 26, 1776, George Washington's troops crossed the Delaware River and surprised Hessian forces in Trenton. The Patriot victory became a turning point in the American Revolution.
